blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Near-term quantum natural language processing (QNLP) experiments often run on classical simulators, so simulator cost is part of the field’s practical compute burden, yet accuracy tables do not show it. We measure that cost for a variational quantum classifier (VQC) on binary SST-2 sentiment classification, using PennyLane’s state-vector simulator over a controlled grid of 27 configurations: three balanced training-set sizes ( N ∈ { 200,500 , 1000 } N\in\{200,500,1000\} ), three qubit counts (4, 6, 8), and three circuit depths. Each VQC is compared with logistic regression on the same PCA-reduced input; full TF-IDF logistic regression gives an uncompressed reference. The VQC beats its matched baseline in 6 of 27 single-seed comparisons. After reruns at two further seeds, only 1 of these 6 keeps a positive mean advantage larger than its paired seed-to-seed variability, and paired tests on the fixed validation set do not establish it. VQC training is 886–21,127 × \times slower in measured wall-clock time than the matched classical fit (median 3,158 × \times ); going from 4 to 8 qubits roughly doubles simulator time, and within the tested range per-step cost is well approximated by a linear function of the parameter count. CodeCarbon energy and CO 2 estimates are secondary: they imply an almost constant power of about 41 W, so they add little beyond runtime, and we do not build an energy ratio from them. The study is narrow (one dataset, representation, ansatz, simulator, and CPU environment) and is a reproducible feasibility measurement, not a general verdict on QNLP.
blocks.zh: 近期量子自然语言处理(QNLP)实验经常运行在古典模拟器上,因此模拟器成本是字段实际计算负担的一部分,然而精确表并没有显示. 我们在二进制SST-2情感分类中, 使用PennyLane的状态演算模拟器, 来测量一个变异量子分类器(VQC)的成本, 将每个VQC与同一PCA减量输入的物流回归相比较;完整的TF-IDF物流回归给出了未压缩的参考. VQC在27个单一种子比较中,有6个比比对基准. 在另外两个种子重播后,这6个种子中只有1个保持了大于其成对种子对种子的变异性的正平均优势,在固定的验证组上进行配对测试不能确定. VQC训练是886–21,127 ×\时间在测量的壁点时间比匹配的古典配位时间慢(中位数为3,158 ×\时间);从4到8个qubit大约是模拟时间的两倍,在测试范围内每步成本与参数计数的线性函数十分接近. CodeCarbon 能量和CO 2 估计值是次要的:它们意味着大约41瓦的功率几乎恒定,所以它们增加的很少超过运行时间,我们不从它们中建立能量比. 研究范围狭窄(一个数据集,表示,ansatz,模拟器,和CPU环境),是一种可复制的可行性测量,而不是对QNLP的一般判断.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Quantum natural language processing (QNLP) asks whether quantum computational structure can supply useful inductive biases for language. It inherits two broad strategies from quantum machine learning ( Biamonte et al., 2017 ; Havlíček et al., 2019 ) . Compositional approaches build a sentence’s grammatical structure into a quantum circuit, following the categorical compositional distributional (DisCoCat) program ( Coecke et al., 2010 ) and its software realization in lambeq ( Kartsaklis et al., 2021 ) ; such models have been executed on quantum hardware for small sentence-classification tasks ( Lorenz et al., 2023 ) . Embedding-style approaches instead encode a fixed-dimensional classical feature vector into a parameterized circuit and train it variationally, as in circuit-centric quantum classifiers ( Schuld et al., 2020 ) ; they are closely related to quantum kernel methods ( Havlíček et al., 2019 ; Schuld, 2021 ) . Current processors are noisy, small, and of restricted access ( Preskill, 2018 ) , so much QNLP experimentation is carried out on classical simulators, with PennyLane one widely used framework ( Bergholm et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 量子自然语言处理(QNLP)询问量子计算结构能否为语言提供有用的诱导偏差. 它继承了量子机学习的两大策略(Biamonte等人,2017年;Havlček等人,2019年). 组成方法将句子的语法结构构建成量子电路,遵循绝对的构成分配(DisCoCat)程序(Coecke等人,2010年)及其在Lambeq的软件实现(Kartsaklis等人,2021年);这些模型已经在量子硬件上执行,用于小的句子分类任务(Lorenz等人,2023年). 嵌入式方法将固定维度的古典特征矢量编码成参数化的电路,并变异地对其进行训练,如在以电路为中心的量子分类器(Schuld等人,2020年);它们与量子内核方法密切相关(Havlček等人,2019年;Schuld,2021年). 目前处理器噪音大,体积小,且访问受限(Preskill, 2018),因此在古典模拟器上进行了许多QNLP实验,PennyLane是一个被广泛使用的框架(Bergholm等人, 2018年).

blocks.en: Simulation is itself a computational workload. A state-vector simulator stores 2 n 2^{n} amplitudes for n n qubits, so memory and arithmetic grow steeply with circuit width, and variational training multiplies the cost of one circuit evaluation by the number of optimizer steps. A result obtained “on 6 qubits” therefore hides the classical compute, and ultimately the electricity, that produced it. Strubell et al. (2019) estimated the energy and carbon cost of training NLP models. Later work proposed standardized reporting practices ( Schwartz et al., 2020 ; Henderson et al., 2020 ) and argued for reporting efficiency as an evaluation criterion. More recent is similar energy and carbon accounting for quantum-circuit simulation ( Li et al., 2023 ; Tripathi et al., 2025 ) . This is relevant in the interpretation of results since quantum machine learning benchmarks can vary significantly based on the experimental setup ( Bowles et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 模拟本身就是计算工作量. 一个状态变量模拟器存储了 n qubits 2 n 2^{n 的振幅,因此内存和算术随着电路宽度的陡增,变异性训练将一个电路评价的成本乘以优化步骤的数量. 因此,“在6qubits上”得到的结果掩盖了古典的计算结果,并最终掩盖了发电结果。 Strubell等人(2019年)估算了NLP模型培训的能量和碳成本. 后来的工作提出了标准化报告做法(Schwartz等人,2020年;Henderson等人,2020年),并主张将报告效率作为一项评价标准。 最近,量子电路模拟的能量和碳核算也相似(Li等人,2023年;Tripathi等人,2025年)。 这与对结果的解释相关,因为量子机器学习基准可以根据实验设置有很大差异(Bowles等人,2024年).

blocks.en: This paper brings these threads together in one deliberately simple, fully logged experiment. For a VQC on binary SST-2 sentiment classification we (i) measure simulator cost under one timing definition applied to both quantum and classical arms, (ii) compare against a classical baseline matched on input dimensionality rather than given a different representation, and (iii) check whether apparent accuracy wins survive reruns at other seeds and paired statistical tests. We vary the training-set size N ∈ { 200,500 , 1000 } N\in\{200,500,1000\} , the qubit count (4, 6, 8), and the circuit depth (1–3 layers), giving 27 configurations, and ask:
blocks.zh: 本文将这些线条集中在一个刻意的简单,完全记录的实验中. 对于关于二进制SST-2情绪分类的VQC,我们(一) 在一个适用于量子和古典臂的计时定义下衡量模拟器成本,(二) 比较与输入维度相匹配的古典基线,而不是给予不同的表示,(三) 检查是否在其他种子和配对统计测试中胜出。 我们改变训练设置的大小 N { 200 500, 1000 } N\in { 200 500, 1100 }, qubit 计数(4, 6, 8), 和电路深度(1–3层), 给出27个配置, 并询问:

blocks.en: • RQ1 (cost). How much measured wall-clock time, and how much software-estimated energy, does simulating VQC training consume relative to a classical classifier on the same compressed representation, and how does the cost scale with qubit count, depth, and training-set size? • RQ2 (accuracy). Does the VQC beat its dimensionality-matched classical baseline under a fixed optimization protocol? • RQ3 (robustness). Do single-seed accuracy comparisons survive targeted multi-seed reruns and paired tests on the fixed validation set?
blocks.zh: • RQ1(费用)。 模拟VQC训练相对于同一压缩表示上的经典分类器消耗了多少墙钟时间和多少软件估计的能量,以及使用qubit计数、深度和培训设置大小的成本尺度如何? • RQ2(准确性)。 VQC 是否在固定优化协议下超越其大小匹配的经典基线 ? • RQ3(波动)。 单种种子精度比较是否在固定验证组上的目标多种复跑和配对测试中幸存下来?

blocks.en: RQ1 (cost). How much measured wall-clock time, and how much software-estimated energy, does simulating VQC training consume relative to a classical classifier on the same compressed representation, and how does the cost scale with qubit count, depth, and training-set size?

blocks.en: Wall-clock time is the primary cost metric. CodeCarbon ( Courty et al., 2024 ) supplies secondary energy and CO 2 estimates, which we do not treat as precise electricity measurements. In brief: matched VQC/classical time ratios are 886–21,127 × \times (median 3,158 × \times ); the VQC leads in 6 of 27 single-seed comparisons, one of which keeps a positive mean advantage larger than its seed-to-seed variability after two further seeds, and none is statistically established.
blocks.zh: 时间是衡量主要成本的标准。 CodeCarbon(Courty等人,2024年)提供二次能量和CO 2估计值,我们不把它视为精确的电力测量. 简而言之:匹配的VQC/古典时间比为886–21,127 ×\时(中位数为3,158 ×\时);VQC领先于27个单一种子比较中的6个,其中1个保持了正面平均优势,大于在另外两个种子之后其种子对种子的变异性,没有一个在统计学上被确定.

blocks.en: The contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic: • a reproducible matched-dimensionality cost measurement for a simulator-based QNLP classifier, with every quoted number recomputed from the exported artifacts by a verification script; • a decomposition of simulator time by qubit count, depth, and optimizer steps, showing that at this width the 4 → \rightarrow 8 qubit growth is about 2 × 2\times , and that within the tested range per-step cost is well approximated by a linear function of the parameter count rather than of the 2 n 2^{n} state dimension; • a targeted multi-seed protocol for apparent accuracy advantages, with explicit regression-to-the-mean caveats; and • diagnostics for near-degenerate predictions, and evidence that software energy estimates carry essentially the same information as wall-clock time in this environment.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: In DisCoCat, a syntactic parse specifies how distributional word representations are combined. The resulting tensor network can then be compiled into a quantum circuit ( Coecke et al., 2010 ) . lambeq implements this workflow as an end-to-end toolkit ( Kartsaklis et al., 2021 ) , and small models of this type have been run on quantum hardware ( Lorenz et al., 2023 ) . Our experiment uses a different formulation: the circuit is a parameterized function of a fixed-dimensional classical input vector ( Schuld et al., 2020 ) . Many classifiers in this family also admit a kernel interpretation ( Schuld, 2021 ) , so we draw no conclusions about grammar-aware QNLP architectures.
blocks.zh: 在DisCoCat中,一个综合解析法描述分布式单词表达式是如何组合的. 由此形成的拉伸网络可以编译成量子电路(Coecke等人,2010年). lampeq将这个工作流程作为端到端的工具包执行(Kartsaklis等人,2021年),这种类型的小模型已经在量子硬件上运行(Lorenz等人,2023年). 我们的实验使用不同的配体:电路是固定维的古典输入矢量的参数化函数(Schuld等人,2020年). 这个家族中的许多分类者也承认了内核解释(Schuld, 2021),因此我们没有得出关于语法意识QNLP架构的结论.

blocks.en: Sufficiently expressive random circuits can exhibit barren plateaus, in which gradients vanish exponentially with system size ( McClean et al., 2018 ) ; we do not measure them and report optimization behavior as an empirical property of the tested stack. Bowles et al. (2024) benchmarked 12 quantum machine-learning models on 160 datasets, found that out-of-the-box classical models outperform the quantum classifiers, and stressed the large effect of experimental design on such comparisons. Our matched-dimensionality baseline, fixed protocol, and multi-seed reruns are small-scale responses in the same spirit.
blocks.zh: 充分表达的随机电路可以显示贫瘠的高原,其中梯度随系统大小成指数消失(McClean 等人,2018年);我们没有测量它们,并且将优化行为报告为测试堆栈的经验属性. Bowles等人(2024年)将12个量子机器学习模型以160个数据集为基准,发现箱外古典模型优于量子分类器,并强调实验设计对此类比较的巨大影响. 我们的匹配维度基线,固定协议,以及多种子重播,都是同样精神的小规模响应.

blocks.en: Energy reporting in NLP predates the present study. Strubell et al. (2019) estimated the energy use and carbon emissions of model training, and Schwartz et al. (2020) argued that accuracy should not be the only evaluation criterion. Henderson et al. (2020) followed with a tracking framework and a standardized reporting scheme for machine-learning experiments. Work on quantum simulation is less extensive. Li et al. (2023) proposed a preliminary model for the CO 2 e of circuit simulation; under that model, a 43-qubit simulation could emit 48 times as much CO 2 e as training a transformer. Tripathi et al. (2025) examined how the choice of ansatz changes this resource cost. In our experiment, wall-clock time is the main cost measure. We report CodeCarbon values only as software estimates and state the assumed grid intensity (India) explicitly.
blocks.zh: NLP中的能源报告早于本研究. Strubell等人(2019年)估算了模型培训的能量使用和碳排放,Schwartz等人(2020年)则认为准确性不应是唯一的评价标准. Henderson等人(2020年)随后提出了跟踪框架和机器学习实验的标准报告计划。 量子模拟的工作不那么广泛. Li等人(2023年)提出了电路模拟的CO 2 e的初步模型;在这个模型下,43 qubit的模拟可以发射48倍于训练变压器的CO 2 e. Tripathi等人(2025年)研究了安萨茨的选择如何改变这一资源成本. 在我们的实验中,墙点时间是主要的成本衡量标准. 我们只将CodeCarbon值作为软件估算,

blocks.en: 3 Task and Data
blocks.zh: 3 任务和数据

blocks.en: We use SST-2, the binary-sentiment split of the Stanford Sentiment Treebank ( Socher et al., 2013 ) , distributed through GLUE ( Wang et al., 2018 ) and loaded from the Hugging Face stanfordnlp/sst2 dataset. 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/stanfordnlp/sst2 The training split contains 67,349 labeled examples (phrases and sentences; 29,780 negative and 37,569 positive); the fixed validation split contains 872 sentences (428 negative and 444 positive). The hidden-label test split is not used.
blocks.zh: 我们使用SST-2,斯坦福感应树库的二进制-感应分裂(Socher等人,2013年),通过GLUE(Wang等人,2018年)发售,从Hugging Face stanfordnlp/sst2数据集加载. 1 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/stanfordnlp/st2 训练分会包含67,349个标注的例子(句子和句子;29,780个负数和37,569个正数);固定验证分会包含872个句子(428个负数和444个正数). 不使用隐藏标签测试拆分 。

blocks.en: From the training split we construct deterministic, exactly balanced subsets of N ∈ { 200,500 , 1000 } N\in\{200,500,1000\} examples using the main seed 42, so class prior is not a confound within training. The same 872 validation examples evaluate every experiment, which makes accuracies directly comparable across qubit count, depth, and training-set size. Because the validation split is mildly imbalanced, the majority-class baseline is 444 / 872 = 0.5092 444/872=0.5092 ; we show it alongside the 0.5 chance reference.
blocks.zh: 从训练的分裂中,我们构建了精确平衡的N {200,500,1000}的子集,N\in {200,500,100}使用主种子42的例子,所以班前不是训练中的错。 同样的872个验证实例评价了每一个实验,这使得精度在方位计数,深度,和训练设置大小上直接具有可比性. 由于验证分拆略有不平衡,多数级基线为444 / 872 = 0.5092 444/872 = 0.5092;我们将其与0.5机会参考一并显示。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 4 实验设计

blocks.en: 4.1 Feature Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.1 地物管道

blocks.en: For each N N , TF-IDF with unigrams and bigrams, sublinear term frequency, and a 3,000-feature vocabulary cap is fit on the training subset only and applied to validation, so no validation information enters the vocabulary or term weights. PCA is then fit on the training TF-IDF matrix and reduces the representation to 4, 6, or 8 components, matching the qubit count. From this single PCA output two representations are derived, each fit on training data only: a standardized version for the classical arm and a linearly rescaled version mapped to [ 0 , π ] [0,\pi] for the VQC arm, as AngleEmbedding expects rotation angles; validation values are clipped to the same interval. The two matched arms therefore consume the same reduced representation and differ only in their classifier.
blocks.zh: 对于每个N N, TF-IDF 带有unigrams和bigrams,子线性术语频率,以及一个3000度的词汇封盖只适合训练子集,并应用于验证,因此没有验证信息进入词汇或术语权重. PCA随后在训练TF-IDF矩阵上合适,并将表示式减少到4,6或8个组件,匹配qubit计数. 从这个单一的PCA输出中推导出两个表示,每个表示只适合训练数据:古典臂的标准化版本和VQC臂的线性调整版映射到[0,π][0,\pi],因为AngleEmbedding期望旋转角度;验证值被剪切到相同的间隔. 因此,两支配对的军火消耗了同样减少的代表性,而且仅在其分类上有所不同。

blocks.en: At N = 1000 N=1000 , the 4-, 6-, and 8-component PCA representations retain approximately 3.4%, 4.7%, and 5.9% of total TF-IDF variance. This is an intentionally severe bottleneck, chosen because near-term qubit budgets force this kind of compression; since PCA is unsupervised, explained variance is not a measure of retained sentiment-predictive information, and the full-TF-IDF baseline is reported to show what the compression costs.
blocks.zh: 在N=1000 N=1000时,4-、6-和8个组成部分的五氯苯甲醚代表保留了约3.4%、4.7%和5.9%。 这是一个故意严重的瓶颈,因为近期的qubit预算迫使这种压缩;由于PCA不受监督,解释性差异不是保留情绪预测信息的一种衡量标准,报告完整的TF-IDF基线显示压缩成本.

blocks.en: 4.2 Classical Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 传统基线

blocks.en: Full TF-IDF logistic regression is the uncompressed reference and uses all 3,000 features. The PCA-matched baseline uses the same 4-, 6-, or 8-dimensional standardized representation given to the VQC. Both use scikit-learn logistic regression with the liblinear solver and max_iter=2000 .
blocks.zh: Full TF-IDF物流回归是未压缩的参考,并使用所有3000个特性. 与五氯苯甲醚相对应的基线使用赋予VQC的相同的4、6或8维标准化代表。 两者都使用 scikit-learn 逻辑回归与 liblinear 解析器和 max_iter= 2000 。

blocks.en: 4.3 Variational Quantum Classifier
blocks.zh: 4.3 量子分类法

blocks.en: The VQC uses PennyLane’s default.qubit state-vector simulator. Each PCA component is encoded with AngleEmbedding using R Y R_{Y} rotations, followed by StronglyEntanglingLayers of depth L ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } L\in\{1,2,3\} (shallow, medium, deep), giving 3 ​ L ​ n 3Ln trainable parameters for n n qubits (12 to 72 across the grid). Weights are initialized from 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 0.1 2 ) \mathcal{N}(0,0.1^{2}) . The circuit outputs ⟨ Z 0 ⟩ ∈ [ − 1 , 1 ] \langle Z_{0}\rangle\in[-1,1] , with zero as the decision threshold. Labels are mapped to { − 1 , + 1 } \{-1,+1\} and optimized with the mean squared error ℒ ⁡ ( θ ) = 1 | B | ​ ∑ i ∈ B ( y i − ⟨ Z 0 ⟩ x i , θ ) 2 , \mathcal{L}(\theta)=\frac{1}{|B|}\sum_{i\in B}\bigl(y_{i}-\langle Z_{0}\rangle_{x_{i},\theta}\bigr)^{2}, (1) using Adam with learning rate 0.1, batch size 16, and 15 epochs. The loss is computed in the same forward evaluation as the gradient, so reporting it adds no second circuit evaluation to the workload. Optimization settings are fixed across the grid, so qubit count and depth are not confounded with different amounts of training.
blocks.zh: VQC使用PennyLane的默认. blocks.en: 4.4 Runtime and Energy Accounting
blocks.zh: 4.4 运行时间和能源核算

blocks.en: Wall-clock time is measured with time.perf_counter around classifier fitting and validation prediction. TF-IDF and PCA are computed once per configuration outside the timed window and shared by both arms, so the timed quantity is the classifier alone under one definition applied symmetrically. Every run is also wrapped in CodeCarbon’s OfflineEmissionsTracker ( Courty et al., 2024 ) with country_iso_code=IND , tracking_mode="machine" , and a one-second power-sampling interval; the offline tracker takes an explicit country setting instead of inferring one from IP geolocation. The timer starts before the tracker is constructed, so every timed run, classical or VQC, includes the tracker’s start-up overhead. CodeCarbon values are software-based estimates, not physical power-meter readings; if tracking fails, the notebook records NaN rather than fabricating a value.
blocks.zh: 长城时间用时间来衡量. perf_ 围绕分类器配置和验证预测进行对答。 TF-IDF和PCA在定时窗口外的每个配置一次计算,由双臂共用,因此,定时数量是同一个对称适用的定义下的单独分类器. 每一次跑步都包裹在CodeCarbon的离线排放跟踪器(Courty等人,2024年)中,有country_iso_code=IND, track_mode="机器",以及一秒的电源采样间隔;离线跟踪器采用一个明确的国家设置,而不是从IP的地理位置推断一个. 计时器在跟踪器构建之前开始,所以每次定时运行,古典运行或VQC,都包含跟踪器的启动间接费用. CodeCarbon值是基于软件的估算,而不是物理功率计读数;如果跟踪失败,笔记本记录的是NaN,而不是虚构一个值.

blocks.en: The main experiment comprises 59 logged rows: 39 base seed-42 rows (27 VQC, 9 unique PCA-matched classical baselines, and 3 full-TF-IDF baselines) plus 20 targeted seed-43/44 reruns (Section 4.6 ). Because a single classical fit lasts only about 0.06–0.10 s, its single-run CodeCarbon estimate is not a reliable basis for a cross-model energy ratio. A separate benchmark therefore repeats each of the 12 unique classical fits 1,000 times inside one tracked workload and records normalized estimated energy per fit; these estimates remain model-based.
blocks.zh: 主要实验包括59个记录排:39个基种-42排(27个VQC,9个独特的五氯苯甲醚匹配古典基线,3个全TF-IDF基线)加上20个目标种子-43/44重播(第4.6节)。 由于单一的古典配体只持续约0.06–0.10 s,其单运行的CodeCarbon估计并不是跨模型能量比的可靠依据. 因此,一个单独的基准重复了12个独特的古典标准中的每个标准,在一个跟踪的工作量范围内达1 000倍,并且记录了每套标准的能源估计数的正常化;这些估计数仍然是以模型为基础的。

blocks.en: 4.5 Experimental Grid and Logging
blocks.zh: 4.5 实验网格和伐木

blocks.en: The base grid is 3 training-set sizes × \times 3 qubit counts × \times 3 depths = 27 =27 VQC runs, matched to the nine unique PCA-classical configurations plus three full-TF-IDF baselines. Each run appends its full record (accuracy, F1, balanced accuracy, prediction rates, wall time, energy, CO 2 , hardware fingerprint) to a persistent results table; validation predictions, trained weights, and per-epoch training losses are saved, so an interrupted session can resume, and mixed hardware sessions would be visible in the logged fingerprints. We flag a run as degenerate when its positive-prediction rate is below 10% or above 90%; this is a descriptive diagnostic threshold, not a statistical criterion.
blocks.zh: 基础网格为3个训练-设置大小 ×\times 3 qubit计数 ×\time 3 深度 = 27 = 27 VQC 运行,匹配9个独特的PCA-经典配置加上3个全TF-IDF基线. 每一次运行都会将其全部记录(准确性,F1,平衡准确性,预测率,墙时间,能量,CO 2,硬件指纹)附加到一个持续的结果表中;验证预测,训练后的重量,以及每个时代的训练损失都会被节省下来,因此中断的会话可以恢复,混合的硬件会话会在被记录的指纹中可见. 当正预测率低于10%或超过90%时,我们就会发现这一下降趋势;这是一个描述性的诊断阈值,而不是统计标准。

blocks.en: 4.6 Targeted Multi-Seed Check
blocks.zh: 4.6 定向多种子检查

blocks.en: Each base configuration runs once at seed 42. Six of the 27 matched VQC comparisons favor the VQC at that seed, with positive deltas of 0.9 to 5.7 accuracy points. These six VQC configurations, with four distinct matched classical baselines, are rerun at seeds 43 and 44, giving three seeds per selected comparison and 20 additional rows. The training subsets stay fixed; the seed changes VQC weight initialization, minibatch order, the randomized PCA solver, and classical solver state.
blocks.zh: 每个基础配置在42号种子运行一次. 27个对应的VQC比较中,有6个倾向于该种子的VQC,正三角形为0.9至5.7的精确点. 这6个VQC配置,有四个截然不同的对应古典基线,在43和44号种子重播,每选一个比较给出3个种子,再增加20行. 训练子集保持固定;种子会改变VQC重量初始化,小批量顺序,随机化的PCA解析器,以及古典解析器状态.

blocks.en: We report the VQC seed-to-seed standard deviation and the standard deviation of the paired VQC-minus-classical deltas. A configuration passes the descriptive robustness rule only when its mean paired delta is positive and larger than its paired-delta seed standard deviation. This rule is not a significance test. Because the selection targets seed-42 winners, it is subject to selection effects and regression toward the mean, which we report rather than hide.
blocks.zh: 我们报告VQC种子到种子的标准偏差以及配对的VQC-减古典三角洲的标准偏差. 一个配置只有在其平均配对三角洲为正数且大于其配对三角洲种子标准偏差时,才会通过描述性强性规则. 这个规则不是一个意义测试. 由于选择对象为42号种子的获奖者,它受到选择效果的制约,并倒退到我们报告而不是隐藏的平均值。

blocks.en: 4.7 Paired Statistical Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.7 Paired 统计分析

blocks.en: For all 27 seed-42 matched comparisons we run exact McNemar tests on the discordant prediction counts over the fixed validation set ( Dietterich, 1998 ) , with Benjamini–Hochberg correction across the 27 tests ( Benjamini and Hochberg, 1995 ) , and a 3,000-replicate paired bootstrap over validation examples for the accuracy difference. These tests evaluate the seed-42 models on one fixed set, whereas the multi-seed analysis (Section 4.6 ) evaluates stability across reruns; the two answer different questions and are reported separately.
blocks.zh: 关于所有27个种子42的比对,我们进行了精确的麦克尼玛测试,对固定验证套数的不和预测数进行了精确的比对(Dieterich,1998年),对Benjamini-Hochberg校正了27个测试(Benjamini和Hochberg,1995年),对准确性差的验证例子进行了3000倍的复制配对。 这些测试对一套固定的42种种子模型进行评价,而多种子分析(第4.6节)则评价整个重播的稳定性;这两个模型回答不同的问题并单独报告。

blocks.en: 4.8 Environment and Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 4.8 环境和可复制性

blocks.en: All 59 rows were produced on one Kaggle CPU runtime: an Intel Xeon at 2.00 GHz (2 physical, 4 logical cores) with approximately 31.35 GB RAM, running Python 3.12.13, PennyLane 0.45.1, NumPy 2.2.6, SciPy 1.15.3, scikit-learn 1.6.1, CodeCarbon 3.3.0, and datasets 5.0.1. A fingerprint of versions, hardware, and configuration constants is exported with the results, and a verification script recomputes every number quoted in this paper from the exported artifacts.
blocks.zh: 所有59行都是在一个Kaggle CPU运行时间上生产的:一个Intel Xeon at 2.00 GHz(2个物理,4个逻辑核心),拥有约31.35 GB RAM,运行Python 3.12.13,PennyLane 0.45.1,NumPy 2.2.6,SciPy 1.153,scikit-learn 1.6.1, CodeCarbon 3.3.0,以及数据集5.0.1. 随结果输出一个版本,硬件,配置常数的指纹,一个校验脚本重新计算本文引用的每个数字来自输出的文物.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Accuracy and Computational Cost
blocks.zh: 5.1 准确性和计算成本

blocks.en: The full TF-IDF baseline improves from 61.1% to 70.0% as N N grows from 200 to 1,000 (Table 1 ). Both matched arms operate under the severe PCA bottleneck and remain close to the 50.92% majority baseline (Figure 1 ): across the 27 seed-42 VQC configurations accuracy spans 47.5%–59.2%, while the PCA-matched classical baselines span 49.3%–59.5%. At N = 500 N=500 and N = 1000 N=1000 the VQC mean is below its matched classical mean by 5.1 and 3.1 points. The difference between the matched arms is therefore not a consistent classifier advantage. Per-configuration results for all 27 seed-42 runs are listed in Appendix A .

blocks.en: The 27 matched VQC/classical time ratios range from 886 × 886\times to 21,127 × 21{,}127\times , with a median of 3,158 × 3{,}158\times : the 27 VQC training runs total 9,663.8 s ( ≈ \approx 2.7 h), while the nine unique PCA-matched classical fits total 0.695 s under the same timing definition. Two features of that definition matter. First, each single classical run lasts only 0.057–0.102 s and so includes a non-negligible share of fixed tracker start-up overhead, which is immaterial for VQC runs of 52–1,212 s. The single-run ratios are therefore conservative : dividing the same VQC times by the amortized per-fit times of the 1,000-repetition benchmark (1.1–1.6 ms for the PCA-matched fits) gives ratios of roughly 4.4 × 10 4 4.4\times 10^{4} to 7.6 × 10 5 7.6\times 10^{5} , with a median of 2.1 × 10 5 2.1\times 10^{5} . Second, the timed window excludes TF-IDF and PCA, which both arms share. We report the single-run ratios as the headline because they apply one timing definition to both arms.

blocks.zh: 5.2 模拟器成本缩放

blocks.en: Data. With batch size 16, the number of optimizer steps is ⌈ N / 16 ⌉ × 15 \lceil N/16\rceil\times 15 (195, 480, and 945 for N = 200 N=200 , 500, 1000), and the mean time per step, averaged over depths, is nearly independent of N N : 0.44–0.47 s at 4 qubits, 0.66–0.70 s at 6, and 0.87–0.91 s at 8.

blocks.en: Within the tested 4–8 qubit range, per-step time is well approximated by a linear function of the parameter count: across the nine (qubit, depth) cells, mean per-step time is fit by 0.053 + 0.0172 × ( 3 ​ L ​ n ) 0.053+0.0172\times(3Ln) seconds with R 2 = 0.999 R^{2}=0.999 . Linear-in-gates scaling is what per-gate simulation and Python dispatch overhead would produce, and it is not what amplitude arithmetic growing as 2 n 2^{n} would produce at n ≤ 8 n\leq 8 ; we did not profile the simulator, so we treat this mechanism as an interpretation. The exponential regime is simply not reached at this width, and these measurements say nothing about where it begins. For budgeting, total simulator cost here is approximately the number of optimizer steps times a per-step cost set by width and depth.

blocks.en: 5.3 Accuracy Across Training-Set Size and Training Dynamics
blocks.zh: 5.3 整个培训组合的准确性 -- -- 培训规模和培训动态

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows accuracy against N N for each qubit count. The full-TF-IDF reference climbs steadily (61.1% → \rightarrow 70.0%), so the task and pipeline support well-above-chance accuracy when the representation is uncompressed; the PCA-matched baseline reaches 57.6%–59.5% at N = 1000 N=1000 . The VQC improves with N N only at 4 qubits, where its mean accuracy over the three depths rises from 50.3% to 54.6% to 58.3% and tracks the matched classical baseline (49.3%, 57.7%, 59.5%). At 6 and 8 qubits the VQC means are 55.6%, 51.6%, 53.8% and 55.0%, 50.8%, 53.9% for N = 200 N=200 , 500, 1000: no monotonic trend, and lower at N = 1000 N=1000 than at N = 200 N=200 by 1.8 and 1.1 points. Across the grid, 5 of the 9 (qubit, depth) cells are more accurate at N = 1000 N=1000 than at N = 200 N=200 , with a mean change of + 1.7 +1.7 points.
blocks.zh: 图3显示每个qubit计数的准确度相对于 N N 。 完整的TF-IDF参考率稳步攀升(61.1% ~\右倾70.0%),因此任务和管道支持在表述不压缩时的精度得到很好的提高;PCA匹配的基准在N=1000 N=1000时达到57.6~59.5%. VQC仅以4qubits的NN改进,其三个深度的平均精度从50.3%上升到54.6%上升到58.3%,并跟踪相应的古典基线(49.3%,57.7%,59.5%). 在6和8qubits时,VQC表示55.6%,51.6%,53.8%和55.0%,50.8%,53.9%的N=200N=200,500,1000:没有单调趋势,在N=1000N=1000比在N=200N=200时低1.8和1.1分. 跨网格,9个(qubit,深度)单元格中,5个在N=1000 N=1000时比在N=200 N=200时更准确,平均变化为+1.7+1.7点.

blocks.en: Training loss tells the same story (Figure 4 ). Across all 39 VQC rows the final-epoch mean training loss lies between 0.93 and 1.01, and it decreased from the first to the last epoch in 38 of 39 runs, by at most 0.15. With labels in { − 1 , + 1 } \{-1,+1\} and an exactly balanced training subset, a constant-zero predictor has a mean squared error of exactly 1, so the circuits fit the training labels only slightly better than a constant. We report this as an empirical property of the fixed 15-epoch, single-learning-rate protocol. Under this compressed representation, additional training examples do not reliably become additional VQC accuracy.
blocks.zh: 训练损失讲述同样的故事(图4). 在所有39个VQC列中,最终阶段的平均训练损失在0.93至1.01之间,在39个列中,从第一个阶段减少到最后一个阶段,最多0.15个。 由于在{−1,+1}中的标签和一个完全平衡的训练子集,一个恒零的预测器有一个正方形的误差准确的1,所以电路只比一个常数更适合训练标记. 我们将此报告为固定的15世纪单一学习率协议的经验财产。 在这种压缩的表述下,额外的培训实例并不能可靠地成为额外的VQC精度.

blocks.en: 5.4 Seed Robustness of Apparent Wins
blocks.zh: 5.4 表面胜利的种子强健性

blocks.en: The targeted reruns show that single-seed improvements are unstable (Table 3 ). Three of the six selected configurations have a negative three-seed mean delta; two remain positive but do not exceed their paired-delta seed variability. Only one passes the descriptive robustness rule.
blocks.zh: 目标重播显示单种子改进不稳定(表3). 6个选定配置中有3个具有负三种子平均三角洲;2个保持正但不超过其配对的三角洲种子变异性. 只有一条通过描述性强性规则。

blocks.en: Table 3: The six configurations whose VQC accuracy exceeded its matched PCA-classical baseline at seed 42. q q is the qubit count (equal to the number of PCA components); shallow, medium, and deep denote 1, 2, and 3 circuit layers. Deltas are accuracy-point differences (VQC − - classical). The descriptive robustness rule requires a positive three-seed mean delta larger than its paired-delta seed standard deviation.

blocks.en: The sole descriptive survivor, N = 1000 N=1000 with 6 qubits and shallow depth, has a three-seed mean delta of + 2.0 +2.0 points and a paired-delta standard deviation of 0.8 0.8 points. However, its seed-42 paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval is [ − 1.7 , + 4.2 ] [-1.7,+4.2] points and the exact McNemar test gives p = 0.450 p=0.450 (BH-adjusted p = 0.639 p=0.639 ). It is thus a descriptive sensitivity result, not a statistically established advantage. The converse case is instructive: the seed-42 N = 200 N=200 , 4-qubit, deep configuration is statistically favorable at that seed after BH correction ( p BH = 0.0017 p_{\mathrm{BH}}=0.0017 , delta + 5.7 +5.7 points) yet falls to a three-seed mean delta of + 0.6 +0.6 points once two more seeds are run. A single-seed win, however significant it looks on one fixed validation set, is not a settled effect.

blocks.en: 5.5 Paired Statistical Tests
blocks.zh: 5.5 Paired统计测试

blocks.en: Across all 27 seed-42 comparisons, 11 have BH-adjusted McNemar p < 0.05 p<0.05 : one favors the VQC (the N = 200 N=200 , 4-qubit, deep configuration just discussed) and ten favor the PCA-matched classical baseline, with differences as large as − 9.6 -9.6 points ( N = 1000 N=1000 , 6 qubits, medium depth, p BH = 3.8 × 10 − 4 p_{\mathrm{BH}}=3.8\times 10^{-4} ). The paired bootstrap agrees: all 11 intervals exclude zero in the same direction. Two further comparisons have bootstrap intervals that exclude zero without a BH-significant McNemar test: N = 500 N=500 , 4 qubits, shallow ( − 3.8 -3.8 points, [ − 7.3 , − 0.2 ] [-7.3,-0.2] , p BH = 0.107 p_{\mathrm{BH}}=0.107 ) favors the classical baseline, and N = 200 N=200 , 6 qubits, medium ( + 3.9 +3.9 points, [ + 0.2 , + 7.7 ] [+0.2,+7.7] , p BH = 0.107 p_{\mathrm{BH}}=0.107 ) favors the VQC. Both VQC-favoring intervals belong to the six seed-checked configurations and neither is robust across seeds (three-seed mean deltas + 0.6 +0.6 and − 0.1 -0.1 points; Table 3 ). The classical-favoring differences, by contrast, were not rerun at other seeds, so they are single-seed results too. Read together, the statistical picture is that where seed-42 differences are detectable they mostly favor the classical baseline, while the VQC’s apparent leads do not survive the multi-seed check.

blocks.en: 5.6 Prediction Behavior and Degenerate Outputs
blocks.zh: 5.6 预测行为和降能产出

blocks.en: Accuracy can conceal unstable prediction behavior, so we report it explicitly. Across the 39 VQC rows the positive-prediction rate ranges from 0.6% to 98.3%, and three runs are degenerate under our rule (rate below 10% or above 90%): N = 500 N=500 , 8 qubits, deep, seed 42 (98.3% positive); N = 1000 N=1000 , 8 qubits, deep, seed 42 (0.6% positive); and N = 200 N=200 , 4 qubits, deep, seed 44 (2.8% positive). All three use the deepest circuit.
blocks.zh: 准确性可以掩盖不稳定的预测行为,所以我们明确报告. 在39个VQC列中,正预测率从0.6%到98.3%不等,在我们的规则下,有3次跑步退化(低于10%或高于90%):N=500N=500N=500N=500N=8qubits,深,种子42(98.3%);N=1000N=1000N=1000N=1 000N=8qubits,深,种子42(0.6%正);N=200N=200N=200N=200N=4qubits,深,种子44(2.8%正)。 所有三个都使用最深的回路.

blocks.en: The highest-F1 configuration in the grid shows why F1 alone is a poor summary here. The N = 500 N=500 , 8-qubit, deep model reaches F1 = 66.6 % =66.6\% , yet its accuracy is 50.1%, its balanced accuracy 49.2%, and it labels 98.3% of validation sentences positive (Table 4 ). It is essentially a majority-class predictor whose F1 is inflated by the all-positive prediction. We therefore treat F1 as a diagnostic at best in this regime and report prediction balance alongside accuracy.
blocks.zh: 网格中最高的F1配置显示了为什么单是F1就在这里是一个差的总结. N=500 N=500,8-qubit,深型号达到F1=66.6%=66.6\%,然而它的精度为50.1%,其平衡精度为49.2%,标注98.3%的验证句为正(表4). 它基本上是一个多数级的预测器,其F1被全阳性的预测膨胀. 因此,我们最好将F1作为这一制度中的诊断,并报告预测平衡和准确性。

blocks.en: Table 4: Confusion matrix on the 872-sentence validation set for the highest-F1 VQC configuration ( N = 500 N=500 , 8 qubits, deep, seed 42). The model predicts positive for 857 of 872 sentences (98.3%); F1 is 66.6% while accuracy is 50.1% and balanced accuracy 49.2%.

blocks.en: 5.7 Energy and CO 2 Estimates
blocks.zh: 5.7 能源和CO 2 估计数

blocks.en: CodeCarbon’s role in this study is descriptive. Its VQC estimates accompany the wall-clock measurements and support the within-VQC scaling in Figure 2 , but they are not physical electricity measurements, and in this environment they add little beyond runtime. The implied mean power (estimated energy divided by tracked duration) lies between 40.8 and 42.1 W for every VQC run and between 40.3 and 42.0 W for every repeated-benchmark workload, and VQC estimated energy correlates with wall-clock time at r = 0.99997 r=0.99997 . The estimates are thus close to a constant power times elapsed time.
blocks.zh: CodeCarbon在这项研究中的作用是描述性的。 它的VQC估计值与壁时测量值相伴,并支持图2中的VQC内缩放,但它们不是物理电量测量值,在这种环境下,它们几乎没有超过运行时间的增加值. 隐含的平均功率(按跟踪时间间隔估计能量)为每一次VQC运行40.8至42.1瓦,40.3至42.0瓦。 每一次重复的基准工作量为W,而VQC估计的能量与壁时时间相关,为r=0.9997r=0.999997. 因此,估计数接近一个持续的时间。

blocks.en: Single-run classical windows, by contrast, imply powers from 10 to 79 W over durations of a fraction of a second, which is why we do not build a cross-model energy ratio from them. The 1,000-repetition classical benchmark gives normalized estimates of approximately 1.27 × 10 − 8 1.27\times 10^{-8} to 3.04 × 10 − 8 3.04\times 10^{-8} kWh per fit under the same software model. The 27 seed-42 VQC runs sum to an estimated 0.1115 kWh and 0.0795 kg CO 2 , which implies about 0.71 kg CO 2 per kWh under the India grid-intensity assumption. We report these values with their provenance rather than as headline claims.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,单运行的古典窗口意味着10至79W的功率超过一秒的一小部分,这就是为什么我们不从它们建立跨模型的能量比. 1000-重复式古典基准给出了大约1.27×10−8 1.27\time 10×8}到3.04×10−8 3.04\time 10×8×8}kWh的正常估计值,在同一个软件模型下每合合. 27个种子-42 VQC的运行总和估计为0.1115千瓦时和0.0795千克CO 2,这意味着印度网格强度假设下每千瓦时约0.71千克CO 2. 我们用这些价值的来源而不是头条索赔来报告。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: In the tested stack, VQC training is roughly three to four orders of magnitude slower than a classical classifier on the same reduced representation, while only 6 of the 27 single-seed accuracy differences favor the VQC (median delta − 1.8 -1.8 points). Reruns show that most apparent wins regress, and the single descriptive survivor is not statistically established. This does not say that VQCs cannot classify sentiment; it says that here the simulator’s cost dwarfs that of its matched classical competitor without a reliable accuracy benefit.
blocks.zh: 在测试的堆栈中,VQC的训练大约比同样减少的表示上的经典分类器慢3到4个数量级,而27个单种子精度差异中只有6个偏好VQC(中间三角圈−1.8-1.8分). 重播显示,最明显的赢家是倒退的,单一描述的幸存者在统计学上没有确定. 这并不是说VQC不能对情绪进行分类;它说模拟器的成本小于它与之相匹配的古典竞争者的成本,但没有可靠的准确性好处。

blocks.en: The 4–8-dimensional PCA representation retains only 3.4–5.9% of the variance of the 3,000-feature TF-IDF space and holds both matched arms near the majority baseline, while full TF-IDF reaches 70.0% at N = 1000 N=1000 on the same subsets. The experiment therefore does not show that VQCs are intrinsically poor sentiment classifiers; it shows what happens when this simulator-based VQC, under a fixed protocol, is trained on this low-dimensional representation. Matching dimensionality avoids confounding classifier with representation, but it does not settle questions of quantum advantage either.
blocks.zh: 4-8维 五氯苯甲醚代表只保留了3 000个面积的TF-IDF空间差异的3.4-5.9%,在多数基线附近持有匹配的武器,而完整的TF-IDF在同一子集上达到70.0%(N=1000 N=1000)。 因此,实验并不显示VQC是内在的情绪差的分类器;它显示了这种基于模拟器的VQC,在固定协议下,在这种低维的表示上接受训练时会发生什么. 匹配维度可以避免将分类器与代表混淆,但也不能解决量子优势问题.

blocks.en: The 4 → \rightarrow 8 qubit factor of about 2 × 2\times , with roughly proportional depth and data scaling, is a calibration point for near-term QNLP practice. The 2 n 2^{n} state-vector cost is the right mental model for large n n , but within the tested range per-step cost is well approximated by a linear function of the parameter count. For budgeting prototypes, simulator time can be modeled as optimizer steps times a per-step cost that grows gently with width and depth, until the exponential term takes over and the same experiment becomes infeasible rather than merely slow.
blocks.zh: 4 ~\右旋8 qubit因子约2 × 2\times,大致比例深度和数据缩放,是近期QNLP练习的校准点. 2n = 2^{n} 状态- vector 成本是大 n n 的正确心理模型, 但是在测试范围内的每步成本被参数计数的线性函数所十分近似. 对于预算编制原型,模拟时间可以模拟为优化步数乘以每步成本,随着宽度和深度而轻轻增长,直到指数期结束,同一个实验变得不可行,而不仅仅是缓慢.

blocks.en: The study suggests four reporting practices for simulator-based QNLP. First, state the timing definition, apply it to quantum and classical arms alike, and say what is excluded (here, shared TF-IDF and PCA) and what overhead is included. Second, use matched-dimensionality baselines and state the compression severity (here, explained variance). Third, verify apparent wins across seeds: our one statistically significant seed-42 win regressed to + 0.6 +0.6 points over three seeds. Fourth, when energy estimates are reported, state the tool’s assumptions (grid intensity, power model) and prefer wall-clock time as the primary metric when the estimates are, as here, a near-constant multiple of it.
blocks.zh: 该研究提出了基于模拟器的QNLP的四种报告做法. 首先,说明时间定义,既适用于量子武器,也适用于古典武器,并说出所排除的内容(这里,共享的TF-IDF和PCA)以及包括哪些间接费用。 第二,使用匹配维度基线,说明压缩的严重程度(此处,解释差异)。 第三,核实各种子的明显胜负:我们一个具有统计重要性的42个种子的胜负,在3个种子中回落到+0.6+0.6分。 第四,在报告能源估计数时,说明工具的假设(电网强度、电源模型),并更喜欢用墙钟时间作为主要衡量尺度,因为如这里,估计数是近乎稳定的倍数。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We asked what it costs to simulate a small quantum sentence classifier when the classical comparison receives the same compressed input. On one dataset, representation, ansatz, simulator, and CPU environment, the answer is 886–21,127 × \times the wall-clock time of the matched classical fit (median 3,158 × \times ; up to 7.6 × 10 5 × 7.6\times 10^{5}\times against amortized per-fit cost) with no reliable accuracy gain: the VQC’s single-seed wins largely disappear under reruns, and the statistically detectable differences mostly favor the classical baseline. Simulator cost is itself an experimental result and should be reported alongside accuracy in QNLP studies, particularly when a quantum model is compared with a classical baseline on a matched representation.
Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: CodeCarbon’s offline tracker reports software-based energy and CO 2 estimates from the observed runtime and its power model. The country_iso_code=IND setting is an explicit grid-intensity assumption, not a measurement of the host’s electricity source. Because the VQC and benchmark estimates imply a nearly constant power, they carry essentially the same information as wall-clock time.
blocks.zh: CodeCarbon的离线跟踪器报导了从观测到的运行时间及其动力模型中得出的基于软件的能量和CO 2的估算. 国家_iso_code=IND设置是一个明确的网格强度假设,不是对宿主电源的测量. 由于VQC和基准估计意味着一种几乎恒定的功率,它们携带的信息基本上与时钟时间相同.

blocks.en: The classical single-fit workloads are extremely short and their timed windows include tracker start-up, so we do not interpret their raw single-run CodeCarbon values as precise energy observations, and the single-run time ratios are conservative. The repeated benchmark improves the measurement window but remains model-based.
blocks.zh: 古典单调工作量极短,其定时窗口包括跟踪器启动,因此我们不将其原始单调CodeCarbon值解释为精确的能量观测值,单调时间比是保守的. 重复的基准改进了计量窗口,但仍以模型为基础。

blocks.en: All 59 rows come from one Kaggle CPU runtime (Section 4.8 ). Results describe this software and hardware environment, not a hardware-independent simulator law; GPU-accelerated or JIT-compiled simulators, different thread counts, or different power models could shift both absolute times and scaling factors. We did not profile the simulator, so the overhead interpretation of the scaling results is untested.
blocks.zh: 所有59行都来自一个Kaggle CPU运行时间(4.8节). 结果描述了这种软件和硬件环境,而不是硬件独立的模拟器定律;GPU加速或JIT编译的模拟器,不同线程计数,或者不同的动力模型既可以改变绝对时间,也可以改变缩放因素. 我们没有描述模拟器,所以对缩放结果的间接解释没有经过测试。

blocks.en: Only the six seed-42 VQC winners were rerun at seeds 43 and 44. The other 21 VQC configurations, and all classical-favoring differences, rest on single-seed estimates. The seed check samples optimization and solver randomness within fixed training subsets; it does not test sensitivity to a different draw of SST-2 training examples, and it does not estimate the win rate over all 27 configurations.
blocks.zh: 只有6名种子42 VQC获奖者在种子43和44重播. 其他21个VQC配置,以及所有的古典偏好差异,都依赖于单种子估计. 种子检查样本在固定的训练子集中优化和解析器随机性;它不测试对SST-2训练实例的不同绘制的敏感性,也不估计所有27个配置的胜率.

blocks.en: We test one TF-IDF/PCA representation, one ansatz ( StronglyEntanglingLayers ), one angle encoding, one loss and optimizer configuration, and logistic regression as the classical classifier. Other representations, classical models, simulators, or compositional QNLP models could give different accuracy and cost profiles; nothing here generalizes to grammar-aware architectures.
blocks.zh: 我们测试一个TF-IDF/PCA的表示,一个ansatz(强进Layers),一个角度编码,一个丢失和优化配置,以及作为经典分类器的后勤回归. 其他表达式,古典模型,模拟器,或组成式的QNLP模型可以给出不同的精度和成本描述;这里没有概括到语法意识架构.

blocks.en: The highest-F1 configuration is selected post hoc and is presented only as a prediction-behavior diagnostic. The six multi-seed configurations are selected after observing seed-42 outcomes, so their rerun statistics are not an unbiased estimate over all 27 configurations.
blocks.zh: 最高的-F1配置是选取的后置配置,仅作为预测-行为诊断. 六个多种子配置都是在观察种子-42结果后选择的,因此其重播统计并不是对所有27个配置的无偏见估计.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This study uses only a public, anonymized benchmark (SST-2) and involves no human subjects or personal data. Its energy and CO 2 figures are software estimates under a stated grid-intensity assumption, not physical measurements, and are presented to promote transparent cost reporting rather than to certify environmental impact. The study is a feasibility measurement on one narrow stack and should not be cited as evidence for or against quantum computing at large.
blocks.zh: 本研究仅使用公共匿名基准(SST-2),不涉及人类主体和个人数据. 它的能量和二氧化碳2数字是在所说明的网格强度假设下进行的软件估计,而不是物理测量,而是为了促进透明的成本报告,而不是证明环境影响。 该研究是一个狭义堆栈的可行性测量,不应作为一般量子计算的证据。

blocks.en: Table 5 lists every seed-42 VQC configuration with its matched PCA-classical baseline, so that each claim in Section 5 can be traced to a row. All values are produced from the exported experiment log and paired-test tables by scripts/make_appendix_table.py .
blocks.zh: 表5列出了每种种子42VQC的配置及其相匹配的五氯苯甲醚经典基线,以便第5节中的每一项索赔可以追溯到一行。 所有值均由导出实验日志和配对测试表格按脚本/make_appendix_table.py.

blocks.en: Table 5: All 27 seed-42 VQC configurations. q q is the qubit count. Δ \Delta is VQC minus the matched PCA-classical accuracy in points. p BH p_{\mathrm{BH}} is the Benjamini–Hochberg-adjusted exact McNemar p p -value across the 27 comparisons. The time ratio is VQC wall-clock time divided by the matched classical run (single-run definition of Section 4.4 ). Bold positive-prediction rates mark degenerate runs (below 10% or above 90%); a third degenerate run occurs at seed 44 ( N = 200 N=200 , 4 qubits, deep; 2.8%). † marks the six configurations rerun at seeds 43 and 44.
